recommendation.primary: Mechanical Garnetting & Fiber Shredding for Non-Woven Acoustic / Thermal Insulation
recommendation.alternative: Color-Sorted Optical Separation & Coarse Open-End Yarn Spinning
recommendation.rationale: The open fringe structure allows low-resistance fiber liberation during mechanical garnetting. Clean post-industrial scrap status eliminates wet washing requirements, preserving fiber length and tensile properties for non-woven automotive or architectural padding.
recommendation.processingMethod: 1. Optical NIR sorting by dominant fiber/color batch -> 2. Rotary cutting into uniform staple lengths -> 3. Mechanical garnetting and carding -> 4. Air-laid web formation and thermal bonding with bi-component binder fibers.
suggestedNextSteps: Perform NIR spectroscopic scanning for precise color and polymer classification
Diverging clean trims directly to rotary cutter / garnetting line
Blend extracted staple fiber with low-melt thermoplastic fibers for non-woven fleece production

recommendations.title: Mechanical Fiber Recycling (Closed-Loop Yarn Spinning)
recommendations.description: Direct mechanical garnetting pulls fabric back into pure individual fibers without breaking polymer chains, preserving organic fiber properties.
technicalSteps: Secondary rotor-spinning blend with 20% organic virgin carrier fiber

recommendations.title: Cellulosic Dissolution Pulping (Circulose Chemistry)
recommendations.description: Chemical dissolution breaks down cellulosic textiles into pure liquid pulp, which is re-extruded into brand-new Lyocell / Viscose staple fibers.
technicalSteps: Chemical cellulose dissolution in eco-solvent bath
Filtration & solvent recovery closed-loop loop (>99.5% solvent recycled)
Spinneret wet-spinning into high-tenacity Lyocell tow

recommendations.title: Non-Woven Automotive & Building Insulation
recommendations.description: Blended or damaged textiles are shredded and needle-punched with low-melt synthetic binder fibers into thermal and acoustic barrier pads.
technicalSteps: Blend with 15% low-melt polyester binder fiber

recommendations.title: High-Value Garment Remanufacturing & Fabric Reuse
recommendations.description: Large intact fabric panels and pristine manufacturing offcuts are redirected directly to fashion upcycling studios for zero-waste garment assembly.
technicalSteps: Direct dispatch to partner circular apparel brands
